title: THC-C032 Integrated Ladder, Tool, and Ergonomic Safety Walkthrough
evidenceOutputs: Completed ladder inspection and access-method decision record
Portable tool pre-use and work-zone control record
Ergonomic exposure observation and redesign worksheet
Stop-work and escalation decisions for injected hazards
Candidate handoff summary with corrective actions and verification steps

domains.name: Ladder selection inspection setup and use

criticalErrors: Uses or authorizes a ladder after identifying a defect that requires removal from service.
Moves or directs movement of an occupied ladder during the assessed task.
Uses or authorizes a powered tool with a missing required guard or a visibly unsafe electrical condition.
Continues work after a simulated electrical or water interaction requires stop-work and escalation.
Directs a manual-handling response that knowingly ignores an immediately controllable equipment or layout hazard.

extensions.recommendedSequence: Complete after all three C032 modules and before course completion handoff.
